We can wholeheartedly recommend the place
Feb 2025 • Couples
Exquisite restaurant on a terrace a short distance above the sea. Great view over the water. 
Very well attended restaurant, which became packed almost every day in the evening; and this already during the pre-season!
They specialize in seafood, but the very extensive menu also contains many other treasures from Indochinese cuisine. For constant fans of Pi-Pa-Italo junk and the french frieze, there is also something to eat.
The majority of the guests were always Asian and as a result the atmosphere was always very relaxed. 
The service was very nimble and friendly. But the nice young men were not very familiar with European languages. Our meager knowledge of the local language was very helpful and received extremely friendly.
Prices for food and also drinks were very cheap.
One evening there was some rain – but this could also be mastered without any problems.
